correspondence.accepted_boundary: 2023.1 useOriginals optional native enable still requires explicit originals/converted under accepted policy; host/SDK/Debug observation limits remain; missing prereqs and preserved FAIL/BLOCKED roots are not passes.
correspondence.presence: Required fields remain required; explicit false/zero/empty arrays and ordered repeated rows retained. Optional transport gameObject and all-active transport are omitted when selected. Meter omitted return/platform/language retain native defaults; empty return remains distinct.
correspondence.resource_lifetime: Only Gateway-issued live transport handles; context/source/row revalidation, execute once, no retry; stop/destroy or paired unregister cleanup; unavailable or ambiguous outcomes retain their separate state.
correspondence.result_delivery: Exact native result retained in execution evidence or bounded read pages; public normalized output and verification outcome remain separate; no direct per-member execution inferred.
correspondence.verification: Native result schema is distinct from business state; cursor returns/readback, owned transport list/state, and bounded capture artifact checks retain their exact scope. Capture enable/start/stop, prepare, media mode and meter registration ACKs do not prove hidden settings, audible output, native capture validity or restoration.
